# Personal Notes during reading "Bayes Rules!"

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This Quarto book collects my personal notes, trials, and exercises during reading "Bayes Rules!"

(The full title of the book is: Johnson, A. A., Ott, M. Q., & Dogucu, M. (2022). Bayes Rules!: An Introduction to Applied Bayesian Modeling (1st ed.). Taylor & Francis Ltd. https://www.bayesrulesbook.com/)


**WATCH OUT: This is my personal learning material and is therefore
neither an accurate replication nor an authoritative textbook.**

I wrote this book as a text for others to read because that forces me to
I need to become explicit and explain all my learning outcomes more carefully.
Please keep in mind that this text is not written by an expert but by a
learner.
